title: Upper semicontinuity of the non-β-flat sets under support and domain convergence (supplied proof, step 12; A.3(3))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, β > 0, S, D ⊆ ℝ^P and S_k, D_k ⊆ ℝ^P (k ∈ ℕ). Notation for this statement: for S, D ⊆ ℝ^P and β ∈ ℝ let R(S, D) be the set of w ∈ ℝ^P for which there are ρ > 0 with B_ρ(w) ⊆ D, a linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P with dim Q = n, and s < βρ such that |(y − w) − p_Q(y − w)| ≤ s for every y ∈ S ∩ B_ρ(w) (p_Q = Q.starProjection, the orthogonal projection onto Q); and let N(S, D) := ((S ∩ D) ∖ R(S, D)) ∪ (ℝ^P ∖ D). (N(spt μ, D μ) is the set sing'(μ) of the parent proof; in the Lean statement R and N are written out.) Assume: closedBall 0 1 ⊆ D; B_1(0) ⊆ D_k for every k; every compact K ⊆ D satisfies K ⊆ D_k for all sufficiently large k; and whenever sub : ℕ → ℕ is strictly increasing, z_k ∈ S_{sub(k)} for all k, z_k → x and x ∈ D, then x ∈ S. Then for every ε > 0 there is k₀ such that for all k ≥ k₀, B_1(0) ∩ N(S_k, D_k) ⊆ {x : there is z ∈ N(S, D) with |x − z| < ε}.
